purpose: camera-ready full-public earlier-method versus final-method comparison

inference.unit: mean of the three frames in each filename-defined acquisition series
inference.test: one-sided exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test on 40 series means

reported_precision.configuration_struct_ms_ssim: Camera-ready aggregate values are retained to six decimal places; the earlier-method maximum was not retained in this compact evidence file.
reported_precision.paired_comparison: The paired mean, confidence interval, and p-value are retained at the available analysis precision.
reported_precision.generation_seconds: Camera-ready values are retained to two decimal places; only the final-method maximum was reported. Exact per-scan timings are regenerated by run.py and are not tracked.

timing_environment: Apple M3 Pro CPU without GPU acceleration
raw_output_policy: run.py regenerates per-scan detail.csv and summary.json files below outputs/; outputs/ is ignored by Git.
